messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-7482 - GPU vmem pressure (cuda::alloc_fail) in pool 'gpu-prod-europe-1'
incident-bot: Trigger conditions: 95th perc GPU mem usage > 92% for 3m, repeated alloc failures in kernels across nodes g-eu-3, g-eu-7
pagerduty: Notifying escalation policy 'eng-oncall-primary' -> paged: Sophia (oncall)
Sophia (oncall): ack'd. Pulling logs and checking dashboards now. 
Sophia (oncall): I'm seeing a spike in `cudaMalloc` failures around 10:02 UTC, correlated with a batch of long-context requests from a tenant workload.
Kevin (sre): copy. Any auto-shed configured? Could be a slow increase on a single model causing KV cache to fill.
Lia (ml-infra): Confirmed - model "chat-xl-sw" long sequences causing KV cache blowouts on those pools. Metrics: `kv_cache_hits` dropped to 12% and `gpu_mem_free` trending to zero.
Sophia (oncall): Initial mitigation: evicting low-priority pods from pool `gpu-prod-europe-1` and enabling auto-fallback to quantized variant. Executing now.
Sophia (oncall): Running command to drain ephemeral jobs from affected nodes:
```
./infractl node drain g-eu-3 g-eu-7 --grace-period=30s --label=evict-candidates
```
ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook 'gpu-memory-pressure' linked -> https://redwood.runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure (steps 1-6).
Kevin (sre): If drain doesn't free enough, we should trigger an emergency scale of dedicated burst nodes (add 2 x A10s) and route new sessions to `gpu-prod-europe-2`. Lia, can you estimate lead time?
Lia (ml-infra): Warm nodes available in ~90s for dedicated burst; provisioning estimate 3m to be fully attached. I can start scale now.
Sophia (oncall): Starting scale request and enabling automatic routing policy to prefer `gpu-prod-europe-2` for new sessions:
```
./infractl fleet scale --pool gpu-prod-europe-1=0 --pool gpu-prod-europe-2=+2 --priority=burst-emergency
```
Sophia (oncall): Paging update: customers affected: customer-azimuth (low-volume error traces), customer-beta-proxy (5% increased error rate). Marking incident P1 for potential customer impact.
Kevin (sre): Noted. Opening a private status thread for Product/CS: pinging @customer-succops to prepare comms.
Sophia (oncall): PagerDuty: ack updated, setting `ack_by` to Sophia. If alloc fails continue after scale, escalate to secondary oncall (Kevin).
pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded for PD#INC-7482 by Sophia (oncall).
incident-bot: Auto-mitigation triggered: enabled fallback-model routing and KV cache aggressive eviction for model "chat-xl-sw".
Lia (ml-infra): Cache eviction appears to be reducing pressure; `gpu_mem_free` on g-eu-3 increased from 200MB -> 1.2GB within 40s. Provisioning burst nodes now (step in progress).
Sophia (oncall): Observed residual `cuda: out of memory` traces on g-eu-7; evicting one hung pod with high persistent allocation:
```
kubectl delete pod pod-hung-7243 -n inference --force --grace-period=0
```
Kevin (sre): If that pod keeps restarting due to faulty client sessions, we should add a transient rate-limit on that tenant. Can you identify tenant id?
Sophia (oncall): Tenant id is tenant-azimuth-11. Applying rate limit throttle to 10 rps for TTL 15m:
```
./platformctl tenant throttle tenant-azimuth-11 --rps 10 --ttl 15m --reason "mitigate GPU mem surge"
```
Sophia (oncall): Burst nodes are healthy and attached. New sessions are routing to gpu-prod-europe-2. Error rate for beta-proxy dropping back to baseline.
Lia (ml-infra): Confirmed: KV cache eviction + fallback + scaling combined reduced alloc errors by ~96% over 2m window.
Sophia (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact; keeping PD incident open for postmortem and rollback verification. Moving to handoff to Kevin for post-incident analysis and follow-up.
Kevin (sre): Taking handoff. I'll collate logs, check if we need a permanent quantization or model config change, and own the postmortem. Assigning owners: Lia for model config, Sophia for runbook updates, Kevin for infra follow-up.
Sophia (oncall): Noted. Adding short notes to incident ticket PD#INC-7482 and creating follow-up task in infra backlog: "Investigate KV cache sizing heuristics for long-context workloads".
ops-runbooks-bot: Created ticket RB-9012 linked to runbook update.
Sophia (oncall): Final note: no rollback needed. Leaving PD incident open until postmortem completed. Will update CS with customer impact summary within 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
